title: IMMANUEL
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: ‘The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel’ (which means ‘God with us’).

session.prompt: Sit in the wonder of Christmas Eve — God with us. Let the name Immanuel settle over every place you've felt alone.

coaching_notes: God with us. If today feels lonely or empty, remember God is with you. And He loves you more than you'll ever know.
